record.name: Harvest
record.one_liner: Harvest provides time tracking and project management software with streamlined invoicing and reporting.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a trial and generate personal access tokens or register an OAuth2 application directly from their account settings.
record.api_note: The REST API covers clients, projects, tasks, time entries, expenses, invoices, estimates, users, and reports.

evidence.quote: A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API.
Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.
Harvest offers a simple pricing model with a 30-day free trial to explore its features.
Complete Harvest API v2 Coverage - 40+ tools covering all major endpoints
